label: Recall
description: Searches long-term memory and writes the matches (list of {key, …}) to a channel.

space.title: Memory space
space.description: Same space + scope = same memories (a Deep Agent's long-term folder uses them too)

scope.title: Shared per
scope.description: user = the run's authenticated user (needs a context field with source 'user')

query.title: Search for
query.description: Jinja template; empty = the most recent memories. Without a semantic index, words are matched.
